boxed_warning: Patients treated with this product are at increased risk for developing serious infections.
warnings_and_cautions: 5.1 Serious Infections Discontinue if a patient develops a serious infection.
5.2 Malignancies Lymphoma and other malignancies have been reported.
adverse_reactions: 6 ADVERSE REACTIONS The most common adverse reactions were upper respiratory tract infection, nasopharyngitis and headache.
6.2 Postmarketing Experience Hepatic failure, pancytopenia and interstitial lung disease have been identified during postapproval use.
